title: Abstention by worst-case bounds for missing inputs in an interpretable additive prescreening model (NHANES): code, knowledge schema and results
description: Code, JSON-LD knowledge schema, analysis protocol, tests and results for a fuzzy additive model that prescreens elevated depressive symptoms (PHQ-9 >= 10) from non-symptom NHANES survey data, with admissible-value bounds and abstention for missing inputs, a bound-guided input acquisition rule, and comparisons with linear bounds, complete-case abstention and imputation-spread abstention. Includes the statistics file that populates the manuscript.
